systems.name: 5.1 Sound Effects & Music
systems.notes: Retro sound effects (chiptune / crunchy samples) and looping level tracks. Use Web Audio API or a simple buffer player.
tasks: Sound effect manager (jump, coin, hit, death)

systems.name: 5.2 Particle & VFX
systems.notes: Low‑poly particles: dust on landing, coin sparkles, teleport swish. Use billboards with dithering.
